observations: Photo 0: a black games console with a three-tier stacked body, 'PS4' printed on the front right and 'STAR WARS' on the front edge, 'SONY' partly visible on the front left.
The three-tier shape is the PS4 Pro, not the original or Slim.
The top carries a Star Wars Imperial crest design in black, white and red; it may be the factory limited edition or an aftermarket skin.
Two black DualShock 4 controllers, a figure-8 power cable and an HDMI cable sit on top.
Light surface wear and dust on the controllers; no cracks visible on the console.
No screen, games or storage information shown; dealer watermark 'Posted on Jiji Game Arena Offical'.

identity.model: PlayStation 4 Pro, Star Wars design, storage unknown

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'PS4' on the front and the three-tier body unique to the Pro.
Marketing description of the model, not something a photo can show for this unit.

risks.risk: Console may not power on, read discs, may overheat, or be banned from online play.
risks.proof: Clip of the console booting to the home screen on a TV, running a game, and the system information screen.

risks.risk: Storage size and whether it is the factory limited edition or a skinned standard Pro.
risks.proof: Photo of the model label on the back and a screenshot of the storage screen.
risks.if_unproven: as a standard PS4 Pro with the smallest storage, skin adds nothing

risks.risk: Controllers may have stick drift, dead batteries or faulty buttons.
risks.proof: Clip of each controller paired and moving in a menu.
risks.if_unproven: as console only, controllers not counted

risks.risk: Photo may not be the seller's own unit.
risks.proof: Photo of the console with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
risks.if_unproven: as the worst condition consistent with the photo

proof_requests: Clip of the console booting on a TV and running a game
Photo of the model label on the back and the storage screen
Photo with a handwritten code in shot
response.reason: The three-tier body and 'PS4' marking identify a PS4 Pro, so it can be priced at its worst case as an untested standard Pro with the smallest storage. A working clip, the model label and controller tests would raise it.
